answer: Each agent may post a claim, but earning the right to trade requires locking a scarce token deposit that is forfeited if the agent double-spends or breaks a signed settlement. A newcomer can still join, yet creating thousands of fake identities multiplies the capital tied up and the risk of slashing; identities alone bring no extra weight. The deposit makes Sybil influence costly rather than impossible, whether an agent routes a dune shipment through a harbor or bids saffron at auction.
